root_cause: Existing source catalog, canonical signal projection, authenticated tenant impacts and action candidates were read by the portal but displayed in disconnected widgets: each signal card omitted exact tenant impact and next best action; unsafe raw external URLs could be rendered without HTTPS protocol restriction.
failedApproach: Counting provider transport success or canonical source novelty as customer-relevant intelligence, or claiming an action candidate is an executed commercial outcome.
fix: Reuse one authenticated Portal V2 entrepreneur_intelligence response, join each source signal to its already tenant-scoped company_impacts and exact signal_key action candidate; show the customer rationale, next step, source freshness and evidence status with strict HTTPS links. Never expose a generic candidate as a materialized tenant action.
prevention_rule: All new portal signals must render source->tenant-specific reason (or explicit context gap)->action/review->truth label; cross-tenant data must never enter the response, and no action DONE or hypothetical value may be labeled provider-proven outcome. Reuse existing schedulers, repository lease and regression gates.
lifecycle: PR candidate; Required/CodeQL and authenticated tenant Netlify production readback not yet completed
